content.what_it_is: MATLAB nesting tool: single-block variant of coupling_file_multi_blocks.m that builds a FUNWAVE-TVD coupling boundary file from coarse-grid station output (NTHMP Wilmington, PRT GridB_NC run). Configuration (L4-L24): foutput and fwriteout both point at PRT_GridB_NC results (L5, L8), station list station_WI.txt (L10), num_blocks=coupling_info(end,3)/4 (L11), iscale=[18] spatial refinement (L13), itscale=[2] time coarsening (L14), starttime=[12000] s with stoptime=starttime+18000.0 (L16-L17), output coupling_PRT_WI.txt (L21), logfile log_PRT_WI.txt (L23). Parameter-length validation (L26-L33). Side encoding east 1, west 2, south 3, north 4 (L35) with per-side station counts and start/end indices (L37-L80), logged (L82-L108). Unlike the multi-block script, the time window indices start/stop/time are computed once before the block loop (L113-L118) using loop variable kk left over from the logging loops. Per side: loads sta_%04d files, extracts eta/u/v columns 2-4 subsampled by itscale (L127-L134), checks coarse-to-fine count (tmp-1)*iscale+1 ?= tmp1 (L140-L148), interpolates each time level to the fine spacing via interp1 (L150-L156), plots a mid-record coarse/fine comparison (L158-L171), and clears eta/u/v (marked comment 'I ADD CLEAR' L173-L175). Repacks sides into (space,var,time) arrays with var order u,v,eta (L181-L210). Writes the coupling file to fwriteout (L212-L228): header, per-side point counts from size(eta_fine{...},2) (L215-L219), 'TIME SERIES' (L220), then per time step the time and four printside calls (L221-L228). Reports start/end times, total steps, approximate interval (L230-L237), clears fine arrays (L239), closes log (L242).
entities: txt log strings L90, L99, L103, L144
eta_fine, u_fine, v_fine cell arrays L153-L155

equations.ref: 4 sides per block encoded in column 3
linear spatial refinement of boundary data

calls: printside L224, L225, L226, L227 (external function)

verbatim_spans.text: iscale=[18];  % spacial refine scale for all blocks
itscale = [2]; % coarsen time scale, skip x output time steps

unresolved: start/stop/time are computed at L115-L117 before the block loop using kk, whose value is whatever the last logging loop left (kk=num_blocks); correct only because num_blocks=1 in this configuration
printside (L224-L227) is an external function not defined in this file

header point counts use size(eta_fine{...},2) (L216-L219) while the multi-block variant uses size(eastfine,1); both equal the fine point count, but this variant omits the duplicate header block written to the log
fcur (L7) and steps (L118) are unused; same zero-station-side crash risk at L78 as the multi-block script; same strict-inequality window selection (L115-L116)
